title: nandha engineering college
content:
NANDHA ENGINEERING COLLEGE

(Autonomous Institution)

Erode, Tamil Nadu, India

title: introduction
content:
Introduction

Nandha Engineering College is one of the premier institutions in Tamil Nadu, known for its excellence in technical education, discipline, and placement achievements. Established with a vision to provide quality education and holistic development, the college is affiliated with Anna University and approved by AICTE.

title: vision & mission
content:
Vision & Mission

Vision

To develop globally competent engineers with strong ethical values and leadership qualities.

Mission

To impart quality technical education. 

To enhance research and innovation. 

To prepare students for industry and entrepreneurship. 

To promote moral and social responsibility.
